subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should dashboard stream/computed bindings be designed separately from allowlisted command-execution bindings, or should all three be approved as one binding surface?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundary for dashboard bindings that periodically execute commands, especially while the underlying dashboard substrate is still outside current main.

options.title: Split command execution design
options.body: Proceed with stream/computed binding design only after the dashboard substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

options.title: Approve unified binding surface
options.body: Accept stream, computed, and command bindings as one feature, with the implementation carrying the full allowlist, permission, audit, and proof burden.

options.title: Defer apps-layer bindings
options.body: Keep the roadmap item open but pause implementation until maintainers decide whether this modular dashboard layer belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Split command execution design
recommendation.body: Proceed with stream/computed binding design only after the dashboard substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is the Control UI plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that this dashboard roadmap reuses.
